He is Professor of Cognitive and Computational Neuroscience at the University of Sussex, Co-Director of the Canadian Institute for Advanced Research’s Program on Brain, Mind and Consciousness, and a European Research Council Advanced Investigator. Seth has published over 160 academic papers and is recognised as a ‘highly cited’ researcher, placing him in the top one per cent of researchers by field. A Wellcome Trust Engagement Fellow, his writing has appeared in New Scientist, Scientific American , the Guardian and Granta , and he features regularly in the media, including on Radio 4’s The Life Scientific .
